that brought us here so suddenly, somehow, without ever taking a step. Or, confused perhaps, she wanders this maze of many castles made into one, looking for its master to prepare you a princely welcome. But there! Look, up there! I see a stir, a commotion, crowds thronging galleries, at windows, at every entrance! Servants, many, scurrying every which way! What else but a fitting reception to honor Your Highness?

@@U03737@@
Ah! How my heart leaps at the sight! Look! Look at them! How decorously they walk, with such calm, unhurried step, those dear, those lovely fair-skinned boys! Down the stairs, so properly they come, and in such order! But how can it be? Who can have ordered, who can have trained so wondrous a company of beautiful lads? And in so little time! What shall I admire most? The grace of their walk, the delicate curls adorning their radiant brows, or their cheeks, ruddy as peaches, and just as downy? I'd bite them if I dared, but of course I don’t; dreadful to tell, but once, in a similar case, the mouth was filled with ashes.
translation:
@@U03735@@
不知何故，它如此突然地将我们带到这里，甚至没有迈出一步。或者，也许她很困惑，在这座由许多城堡组成的迷宫中徘徊，寻找它的主人为你准备一场王子般的欢迎。但是就在那里！看，上面！我看到一阵骚动、一阵骚动，人群挤满了画廊、窗户前、每个入口！仆人很多，到处乱窜！除了为殿下举办一场合适的招待会之外，还有什么别的办法呢？

@@U03737@@
啊！我的心一看见就狂跳！看！看看他们！亲爱的、可爱的白皙男孩，他们走得多么优雅，步伐是多么平静、从容！他们走下楼梯，来得如此正确，而且是按这样的顺序！但怎么可能呢？谁能下令、谁能训练出如此出色的一群美丽小伙子？而且是在这么短的时间内！我最欣赏什么？他们优雅的步态，精致的卷发装饰着他们容光焕发的眉毛，还是他们红润如桃子般柔软的脸颊？如果我敢的话我会咬它们，但我当然不会；说起来很可怕，但有一次，在类似的情况下，嘴里充满了灰烬。
